description: This header file declares functions and constants for managing device URIs, reading and writing device resources and metadata, and querying device endpoints within a device service SDK. It provides a high-level interface for device interaction, including URI creation, resource access, and endpoint discovery.

methods.name: createDeviceUri
methods.description: Creates a URI string for a device given its UUID.

methods.name: createEndpointUri
methods.description: Creates a URI string for a device endpoint given device UUID and endpoint ID.

methods.name: createDeviceResourceUri
methods.description: Creates a URI string for a device resource.

methods.name: createDeviceMetadataUri
methods.description: Creates a URI string for device metadata.

methods.name: createEndpointResourceUri
methods.description: Creates a URI string for an endpoint resource.

methods.name: createEndpointMetadataUri
methods.description: Creates a URI string for endpoint metadata.

methods.name: deviceHelperReadEndpointResource
methods.description: Reads a resource from a device's endpoint.

methods.name: deviceHelperWriteEndpointResource
methods.description: Writes a resource to a device's endpoint.

methods.name: deviceHelperReadDeviceResource
methods.description: Reads a resource from a device.

methods.name: deviceHelperGetResourceByUri
methods.description: Retrieves a resource object by its URI.

methods.name: deviceHelperReadResourceByUri
methods.description: Reads a resource value by URI.

methods.name: deviceHelperReadMetadataByUri
methods.description: Reads metadata value by URI.

methods.name: deviceHelperWriteMetadataByUri
methods.description: Writes metadata value by URI.

methods.name: deviceHelperReadMetadataByOwner
methods.description: Reads metadata by owner URI and ID.

methods.name: deviceHelperWriteMetadataByOwner
methods.description: Writes metadata by owner URI and ID.

methods.name: createResourceUri
methods.description: Creates a resource URI for either a device or endpoint.

methods.name: getDeviceUuidFromUri
methods.description: Extracts device UUID from a URI.

methods.name: getEndpointIdFromUri
methods.description: Extracts endpoint ID from a URI.

methods.name: deviceHelperGetDeviceResourceValue
methods.description: Gets the value of a device resource.

methods.name: deviceHelperGetEndpointResourceValue
methods.description: Gets the value of an endpoint resource.

methods.name: deviceHelperGetEndpointByProfile
methods.description: Finds the first endpoint with a given profile.

methods.name: deviceHelperIsMultiEndpointCapable
methods.description: Checks if a device supports multiple endpoints.
